chunks: There is not one of us who does not have his appointed place,

key_terms.مِنَّا: From us (referring to the Ahl al-Bayt/Imams)

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Maqam Ma'lum' for the Imams in Shia theology?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as referring specifically to the Ahl al-Bayt, affirming that each Imam possesses a unique, divinely ordained station (maqam) and role within the cosmic hierarchy. This concept underscores the continuity of divine guidance through the Imams, who serve as the authoritative interpreters of revelation and the spiritual successors to the Prophet.
